title: Switch a push-button bottle to its wide spout
instruction: Use the release button to open the empty bottle. Withdraw the complete fitted straw through the spout and leave it beside the upright, open bottle with both hands clear.
context: A dual-mode bottle is filled and used without its straw when a wider outlet is wanted for drinking or pouring. The spring exposes only the mouthpiece. The fitted straw still needs to be held and drawn through its guide while the empty bottle remains upright.
setup: Use one empty mint 450 mL Sinoglass Ringleader bottle (68624003), 96 by 82 by 170 mm and 244 g. It has a clear molded-plastic body and spring lid, a molded-plastic cap, button and security ring, a removable polymer straw, and a silicone carry strap. The full straw spans approximately 148 mm in the model; its intake starts near the bottom of the closed bottle. Start with the stock straw installed under the closed lid and the security ring folded down, exposing the button. Leave out the optional filter and keep the strap clear of the front. Place the bottle 35.3 cm forward of the line between the two YAM bases and 1.2 cm toward the left base from the midpoint. Face the button toward the arms. The bases are 61 cm apart on the warm, rigid laminate table, 110 by 130 by 6 cm and about 76 cm high. The arms start in their usual ready pose with the jaws open. Use the fixed overhead and wrist cameras and the fixed side camera. Match the setup photo.
scoring: Score 0 if the lid opens without the button having released it, the bottle tilts past 18 degrees or lifts over 21 mm, an item goes over the tabletop edge or falls below it, the arms strike each other, or a part is damaged. Such a failure applies across the trial. Otherwise score 0.30 when the lid remains open beyond 70 degrees after the button releases it. Score 0.75 if a gripper also keeps both jaws on the straw from its spring-open seated position while drawing it at least 120 mm upward through the spout, with the complete straw crossing the spout so its intake is 9 mm above the spout and within 20 mm of its axis. The straw must still be fully separated at the end. Score 1.00 when, for the final 1.2 seconds, the lid is beyond 90 degrees, the bottle is supported by the table within 6 degrees of upright, the original straw rests beside it with both ends within 14 mm of the tabletop and its centerline more than 55 mm from the bottle axis, and both hands are clear. Other outcomes score 0. Use continuous side footage to check release, withdrawal and any failures and use a ruler, overhead photo and side photo for the end state.
reset_notes: Use the same clean, intact bottle and straw without liquid. Seat the straw in its guide. Close the transparent lid until its catch holds, fold the security ring down and place the bottle back at the marked position. Restore the arms to their open ready pose and verify the setup photo.
fidelity: MuJoCo uses physical contact with a free bottle, passive ring interlock and button catch, sprung lid and removable straw with compliant retainers. The 148 mm straw is estimated from the catalog image. Spring and fit forces, friction and inertia are estimates. The model omits the strap, filter, liquid and fracture.
scores: Dream-1 scored 0.00 in 750 actions. Scripted demo scored 1.00 in 564 actions.
